name: MKT_SEM_ACCT_RESULTS
description: This table will be used to store the statistics based upon a SEM Account

columns.name: CONNECTIONID
columns.description: The account ID of SEM Account

columns.name: REPORTDATE
columns.description: Report Date for the account report

columns.name: IMPRESSIONS
columns.description: Number of impressions recorded for a given date for a given account

columns.name: CLICKS
columns.description: Number of clicks recorded for a given date for a given account

columns.name: CTR
columns.description: Number of CTR recorded for a given date for a given account

columns.name: AVGCPC
columns.description: Number of Avg CPC recorded for a given date for a given account

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Cost recorded for a given date for a given account

columns.name: AVGPOSITION
columns.description: Number of Avg Position  recorded for a given date for a given account

columns.name: AVGCPM
columns.description: Number of average CPM recorded for a given date.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
